purpose: Prevent rejected ideas from being silently reintroduced and keep the scale-separated ACSP main line explicit.

components.evidence: Campanula cached candidate pools could recover only 13/19 field clusters at 1 km; full-island generation removed the upstream ceiling.

components.rule: use thinning to reduce duplicate-record dominance; do not interpret the thinning distance as a universal biological scale
retain the frozen Practical Core interpretation and fingerprint; do not infer occupancy or suitability probability

components.evidence: Strong maximum-new-coverage selection repeatedly dominated weaker geometry controls and remained the strongest transferable fine-scale structure after ecological modifiers failed.
The sparse selector passed exact-equivalence tests in research workflows and is now promoted to a reusable package set selector with deterministic input-order tie breaking.
The 793-point/1-km design produced random saturation and the 12-island operational audit showed fixed K=5 represents 2-5 field days rather than a common budget.

All 12 island jobs passed the outcome-free operational contract. Under the production vascular-plant reconnaissance proxy, fixed K=5 required 2-5 days (median 2); day budgets produced island-specific K rather than assuming one universal stop count.
components.limits: Hub choice affects the exact K increasingly at longer budgets; the five-day within-island K range across deterministic hub proxies had median 4.5 and maximum 10. Actual road/trail/ferry access remains unvalidated.

components.rule: use training information only to decide whether a terrestrial policy is applicable; keep deployment information adequacy separate from retrospective benchmark evaluability
random alone is insufficient when geometry can dominate; environmental value must beat a matched strong geometry-only control
development choices may not use outer or confirmation outcomes; inspected cohorts are never recycled as confirmation

components.evidence: Campanula-derived rankings lost to matched random on unseen Izu taxa and low-budget sweeps did not show stable transfer.
The 0.90 NDVI + 0.10 microclimate rule failed the predeclared 16-taxon Izu transfer.

components.development_evidence: q=0.10/K=5 showed +0.030 lift over q=1 geometry-only on 16 Izu development taxa and survived cross-taxon jackknife consolidation.
components.external_failure: On 24 new taxa / 12 islands the frozen method had mean lift +0.020873 but bootstrap CI crossed zero, exact p=0.15625, and eligible-pair rate was 0.625; the predeclared confirmation failed.
components.budget_representation_failure: On a separate 24-pair operational development cohort, replacing fixed K with equal land-grid design-footprint curves yielded normalized-AUC lift +0.002752, bootstrap CI [-0.011697,+0.015926], p=0.35645.
components.rule: do not retune q, NDVI features, prototype representation, or thresholds on any inspected cohort

components.evidence: The low-budget Izu signal did not transfer externally and did not survive coverage-equivalent redevelopment.
It selected q=1 in 60/80 folds and optimized an internal reconstruction target misaligned with survey recovery.
K5 lift over global coverage was only about +0.009 with CI crossing zero; K10/K20 were not improved.
Multimodality was detected but equal search opportunity degraded fixed-q10 recovery.
k=2/3 did not improve k=1 and fully nested (k,q) selection did not beat geometry-only.
Point-only, 100 m-only and 250 m-only variants did not improve the current multiscale reference; nested selection failed.

components.rule: the conceptual transition idea may only return with a genuinely new representation and new development data

components.evidence: It removed genuine Campanula detections or required excessive expansion; patches belong downstream as field representation.

components.rule: geometry survives as a set objective rather than an additive score bonus
route and patch structure are operational outputs only
accept explicit user hub/road/trail/ferry constraints; do not infer them as biological suitability

components.requirement: attempted sites, standardized non-detections, effort, season/detectability and access outcomes are required before claiming discovery-per-day or detection-yield learning

anti_churn_rule: Do not reopen rejected fine-scale NDVI/support families by threshold or feature retuning. New experiments must name one unresolved layer, preserve retained components, and use the strongest relevant control.
